Premium Quality Box Truck Wraps in GTA – 3M and Avery

Are you looking for a premium quality vinyl wrap for your box truck? Look no further. At Vinyl Wrap Toronto, we have the right crew and equipment to get you the best box truck wrap. Here’s why you should consider us:

  • We only use premium quality material by Avery Dennison and 3M to wrap vehicles.
  • Our vinyl wrap installers have years of experience so we pay close attention to detail.
  • Our designers are creative enough to come up with interesting concepts with the least direction.
  • Our garage is fully equipped to wrap your vehicle with utmost care.
  • Fast turnaround time.

Feel free to give us a call at 416-746-1381 or visit our garage located at 24 Ronson Dr, Unit 1, Etobicoke, ON, M9W 1 B4 to learn more about box truck wrap cost, car wrap cost or ask any other questions.
